about_the_game:
Twilight Tails is a thrilling interactive adventure where you step into the paws of a raccoon fighting to survive in the mysterious wild. Venture into the unknown, where every bush, tree, and underground tunnel hides secrets and challenges.

Key Features:

  • Realistic Wild Environment: Immerse yourself in a picturesque world of forests, mountains, and waterscapes, competing for survival among other wild animals.

  • Weather and Seasonal Changes: Experience the effects of storms, snowfall, and spring blooms on your survival strategies.

  • Shelter and Trap Building: Showcase your survival skills by building shelters and placing traps to outsmart predators and secure your territory.

  • Co-op Mode: Survive solo or form alliances with other players to share responsibilities like gathering food and defending from predators.Available within a month after release

Twilight Tails takes you to the heart of nature, where every day is a new challenge and an unforgettable adventure. Explore the mysterious forest with your own paws, prove your survival prowess, and master the art of shelter and trap crafting.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3470 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 470

short_description: Twilight Tails is a captivating game where you become a raccoon navigating a challenging forest. Fight for territory, survive changing seasons, and evolve in multiplayer adventures. Conquer the jungle, rule survival!
